text: Long running agents forget why they ran old experiments. Second Shift keeps the whole campaign in MongoDB Atlas, and rebuilds every decision from that evidence.
The workload is real brain signal data. Claude picks each experiment and cites evidence. Code computes every number.
Now we kill the worker mid job. A new process rebuilds from Atlas, reuses the finished work, and reruns the orphaned job.
We wipe the context and cut the electrode budget from sixty four to nine. It reranks what it measured, and keeps going.
Each decision sees a small evidence packet. Jev routes notes into memory, and Vector Search brings them back.
Measured today: all thirteen recovery and constraint checks passed, and context stayed near twelve hundred tokens at ten thousand notes.
One persistent mission. Bounded context. Measured results.
